g.text: Repeated 8 times. Only Q changes between blocks; the same M is supplied to every cross-attention layer. Shapes omit the pair batch axis P.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183042
font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #506477

g.text: Every attention module has 8 heads, model width 512, and attention dropout 0.1. The circles are residual additions.

g.text: The final block output is E = Q⁸. DualUVHead consumes E directly; no face feature or memory concatenation is inserted before that head.
